tools.description: Score products and practices against the CFPB UDAAP framework (Unfair, Deceptive, Abusive Acts or Practices) under Dodd-Frank Section 1031. Weighted risk flags and recommended controls. Client-side. Zero PII.

Regulatory flags for FCA FG24/1, EU IDD, ASIC DDO jurisdictions. Sensitivity analysis across loss ratio and attachment rate.

tools.name: calculate_solvency_ii_scr
tools.description: Calculate indicative BSCR under Solvency II Standard Formula (CDR EU 2015/35). Computes non-life premium and reserve risk (Annex II factors), market risk (equity 39/49%, IR duration-approximation, property 25%, FX 25%), counterparty default Type 1 (PD by rating, LGD 50%), and aggregates with prescribed correlation matrices. Returns module-level SCR breakdown, BSCR, diversification benefit, and optional SCR coverage ratio. Note: excludes operational risk SCR, LACTP/LACDT, life/health UW modules.

tools.name: check_priips_kid_compliance
tools.description: Evaluates a PRIIP KID against Regulation (EU) No 1286/2014 and Level 2 RTS requirements. Returns compliance status, 0-100 score, list of critical failures, and remediation actions.

tools.description: Calculate financed emissions for a retail lending portfolio using the PCAF Global GHG Accounting and Reporting Standard Part C. Covers residential mortgages, auto loans, personal loans, and credit cards. Zero PII. Client-side.

tools.name: 451_sr11_7_model_risk_management_gap_assessor
tools.description: Evaluate your institution's model risk management framework against Federal Reserve SR 11-7 / OCC 2011-12 guidance (superseded 2026-04-17 by SR 26-2; see the SR 26-2 Model Risk Management Gap Analyzer for a current assessment). Scores model development, validation, governance, and inventory practices with gap identification and remediation priorities.

tools.name: assess_fair_lending_ai_bias
tools.description: Assesses an AI/ML credit model for fair lending compliance risks across transparency, disparate impact, adverse action, governance, and regulatory exposure dimensions.

tools.name: 453_account_takeover_detection_policy_builder
tools.description: Build a customised ATO detection policy for financial services firms. Evaluates authentication controls, step-up triggers, and post-takeover response. Generates a structured policy framework. Client-side. Zero PII.

tools.name: 454_first_party_fraud_mule_detection_framework
tools.description: Identify first-party fraud risk indicators and money mule typologies across retail banking portfolios. Score accounts for elevated risk, with SAR triggers and investigative priorities. Client-side. Zero PII.

tools.name: analyze_pc_combined_ratio
tools.description: Compute P&C Loss Ratio = (incurred losses + LAE) / earned premium, Expense Ratio = underwriting expenses / (written or earned premium), Combined Ratio = loss + expense, and optional Operating Ratio = combined - investment yield. Benchmark the combined ratio against published industry medians (AM Best 2024/2025, NAIC 2024) by line of business, assign a colour-coded adequacy zone (green <95%, amber 95-105%, red >105%), and flag the NAIC IRIS solvency-screening threshold (combined ratio > 115%). Returns ratios, zone, IRIS flag, and benchmark deltas.

tools.name: price_reinsurance_burning_cost
tools.description: Price an excess-of-loss reinsurance layer by the burning cost method. Trends historical ground-up losses to the prospective period, applies an IBNR load and exposure adjustment, computes the as-if layer loss per accident year (min(max(developed-attachment,0),limit)), and divides total layer losses by total subject premium to get the burning cost rate. Returns technical rate (BC / target loss ratio), technical premium, expected layer loss, reinstatement cost, and a low-credibility flag. Use when an agent needs an experience-rated indicative price for a treaty XL layer. Supplement with exposure rating for thin/high layers.

tools.name: calculate_naic_rbc_ratio
tools.description: Calculate a simplified NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) ratio for a US P&C insurer. Computes asset risk charges (R0 affiliates 10%, R1 fixed income weighted rate, R2 equity 15%, R3 credit 5–10%) and underwriting risk charges (R4 reserves, R5 premium by line of business), applies the covariance square-root aggregation RBC_after_cov = R0 + sqrt(R1^2+R2^2+R3^2+R4^2+R5^2), derives Authorized Control Level RBC = RBC_after_cov/2, and returns the RBC ratio against the NAIC action levels (CAL 200%, RAL 150%, ACL 100%, MCL 70%). Simplified standard formula — indicative.

tools.name: design_parametric_trigger
tools.description: Design a parametric insurance / catastrophe bond trigger structure and estimate basis risk. Computes expected annual payout = (freq_attach + freq_exhaust)/2 × avg_payout_factor × limit; risk premium = E[Payout] × (1 + risk_load); technical rate on line = premium / limit; basis risk via expected basis risk loss = (1 − r²) × loss-spread proxy, expressed as % of limit; and a settlement speed score by trigger type. Returns probability summary, premium indication at multiple risk loads, basis risk dashboard, and trigger-type comparison. Premium is illustrative only — not a binding quote.

tools.name: test_ratemaking_adequacy
tools.description: Test P&C insurance rate adequacy with the pure premium / loss-ratio method (CAS Exam 5; CAS Statement of Principles). Supply up to 10 accident-year rows (earned exposures, earned premium, incurred losses+LAE, claim counts, current rate level factor), loss/premium trend, variable & fixed expense and profit provisions, and credibility settings (square-root or full; default full-credibility 1,082 claims). Returns on-level premium, exposure-weighted trended pure premium, permissible loss ratio, indicated rate change, credibility weight Z = min(sqrt(n/n_full),1), the credibility-weighted indication, an adequacy verdict, and a trend/PLR sensitivity grid. On-level factors and loss development must be supplied by the caller. Deterministic, client-side, zero PII.

tools.name: compare_solvency_regimes
tools.description: Compare required and available insurer capital across four international solvency regimes — EU Solvency II SCR (simplified standard formula per CDR 2015/35), NAIC RBC (simplified R0–R5 + covariance), Bermuda BSCR Class E (market+insurance+credit -> ECR), and IRDAI Solvency Margin (RSM = max(50% NWP, prescribed % net claims)) — from one shared simplified balance sheet. Returns a regime comparison table, the binding capital constraint, per-regime solvency ratios and excess buffers, and a sensitivity view. Simplified approximation — indicative only; use T447 for full Solvency II SCR and T457 for full NAIC RBC.

tools.name: model_cyber_accumulation_pml
tools.description: Estimate portfolio-level cyber PML at multiple return periods (1-in-10/50/100/250) by systemic scenario (mass ransomware, cloud outage, critical infrastructure, supply chain) using published severity curves (IBM/Ponemon 2024, FBI IC3 2024) and Lloyd's RDS 2024 scalars. Returns attritional expected loss, per-scenario and combined PML, loss-ratio stress, concentration indicators, and an accumulation alert at >25% of aggregate limit. Inputs are synthetic aggregates only — never policyholder-level data.

tools.name: check_claims_reserve_adequacy
tools.description: Run Chain Ladder (development) and Bornhuetter-Ferguson reserving on a cumulative loss development triangle. Computes volume-weighted/simple/3yr/5yr/manual age-to-age factors with optional tail factor and latest-diagonal exclusion, LDFs to ultimate, % unreported, chain-ladder and B-F ultimates and IBNR by accident year, a blended selected IBNR, and a reserve adequacy signal (redundancy/deficiency) versus a booked reserve. Flags CL-vs-BF divergence beyond 15% and low-credibility triangles (<5 accident years or <3 development ages). Methods per CAS/Friedland (2010) and Bornhuetter-Ferguson (1972). Deterministic, client-side, zero PII.

tools.name: reg_bi_best_interest_checker
tools.description: Assess a securities recommendation against SEC Regulation Best Interest (17 CFR 240.15l-1). Scores all four component obligations: Disclosure (Rule 15l-1(a)(2)(i)), Care (Rule 15l-1(a)(2)(ii)), Conflict of Interest (Rule 15l-1(a)(2)(iii)), and Compliance (Rule 15l-1(a)(2)(iv)). Returns PASS/GAP per obligation, overall best-interest verdict (BEST_INTEREST_MET / ATTENTION / NOT_MET / OUT_OF_SCOPE), and ordered remediation steps. Deterministic. 2026 FINRA enforcement priority. Use with synthetic inputs only.

reasonably_available_alternatives_consid.description: Number of reasonably available alternatives considered before making the recommendation

total_cost_bps.description: Total cost to the retail customer in basis points

lower_cost_alternative_exists.description: True if a lower-cost alternative was identified in the considered set

conflicts_disclosed.description: True if material conflicts of interest were disclosed in writing

conflicts_mitigated.description: True if conflicts of interest were mitigated or eliminated through written policies

form_crs_delivered.description: True if Form CRS was delivered to the retail customer at or before the recommendation

rationale_documented.description: True if the recommendation rationale (basis for best interest) was documented

compliance_program_in_place.description: True if a written compliance program reasonably designed to achieve Reg BI compliance is in place

tools.name: form_crs_generator
tools.description: Generate a Form CRS (Customer Relationship Summary) with SEC-prescribed headings and verbatim conversation-starter questions (SEC Form CRS General Instructions §E). Checks page-length compliance: 2-page limit for standalone broker-dealers or investment advisers; 4-page limit for dual registrants. Required Reg BI disclosure for every retail investor engagement. Markdown export is the filing-ready deliverable. Use with synthetic firm data only.

monitoring_offered.description: True if ongoing account monitoring is offered

discretionary_authority.description: True if the firm exercises discretionary authority

material_conflicts.description: List of material conflicts of interest to disclose

disciplinary_history.description: True if the firm or its professionals have legal or disciplinary history

tools.name: carf_dac8_reportable_classifier
tools.description: Classify a CASP and its users/transactions as reportable under OECD CARF and EU DAC8. Determines Reporting-CASP status per CARF §II; classifies user residency against the 52-jurisdiction CARF participating list (Jan 2026); classifies transactions by type (exchanges always reportable; retail payments ≥ USD 50,000; unhosted wallet transfers). CARF effective 1 Jan 2026; DAC8 (EU Directive 2023/2226) for FY2026. US implementing CARF exchange from 2027. Use synthetic data only.

entity_type.description: CASP entity type per CARF §II Reporting CASP definition

regime.description: Applicable regime: carf (non-EU jurisdictions), dac8 (EU member states), or both

user_residencies.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 residency codes for each user to classify

transactions.description: Transactions to classify; retail_payment threshold is USD 50,000 per CARF §II.D.3

tools.name: crypto_cost_basis_gain_calculator
tools.description: Compute crypto-asset cost basis and realized gain/loss per disposal. Supports FIFO, LIFO, HIFO, and specific-identification lot matching. Enforces per-wallet basis tracking when enabled (required for US taxpayers from 2025 per IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-28). Short/long-term split at 12-month threshold (IRC §1222). Output gain_loss_schedule feeds IRS Form 1099-DA generation (T467) and CARF/DAC8 reporting. Deterministic lot accounting — do not estimate gains with an LLM; use this tool. Synthetic data only.

method.description: Lot-matching method: FIFO=first-in-first-out; LIFO=last-in; HIFO=highest-cost-first; spec_id=taxpayer designates each lot

wallet_by_wallet.description: Restrict lot matching to same wallet (required for US from 2025)

tools.name: form_1099_da_generator
tools.description: Assemble IRS Form 1099-DA records from digital asset disposal and basis data. Validates completeness per IRS final broker-reporting regulations (TD 9996, June 2024). Gross-proceeds reporting required from 1 Jan 2025; basis (Box 1d) required for covered digital assets acquired on/after 1 Jan 2026. Applies IRS Notice 2025-7 transitional penalty relief notation for tax year 2025. Output contains complete/incomplete flags for each record and a filing CSV extract. Consumes output from T466 crypto-cost-basis-gain-calculator. Verify box numbers against current IRS Form 1099-DA instructions before filing. Synthetic data only.

disposals.description: Disposal records to assemble into 1099-DA entries; typically sourced from T466 gain/loss schedule

tools.name: casp_tax_reporting_readiness_scorer
tools.description: Assess a CASP's readiness for CARF (OECD, effective 1 Jan 2026), DAC8 (EU Directive 2023/2226, FY2026), and IRS Form 1099-DA (TD 9996) reporting obligations. Scores five weighted domains and returns an A–F grade with a prioritised gap list linked to T465 (CARF classifier), T466 (cost-basis calculator), and T467 (1099-DA generator). Use at programme-initiation or quarterly readiness review. Synthetic inputs only.

regime.description: Regime scope: both=CARF+DAC8+1099-DA; carf_only; dac8_only; us_only=IRS 1099-DA only

tools.name: lcr_calculator
tools.description: Calculate the Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) per BCBS 238. LCR = HQLA (after haircut and caps) / Net Cash Outflows (30-day stress, inflow cap 75%) ≥ 100%. HQLA haircuts: Level 1 = 0%; Level 2A = 15%; Level 2B = 25–50%. Outputs compliant flag, surplus/(shortfall), and feeds Pillar 3 LIQ1 (T472). Verify haircut and outflow rates against applicable jurisdiction LCR rules. Synthetic data only.

hqla_items.description: HQLA stock — level, asset description, and market value

inflow_items.description: 30-day stress inflow categories (capped at 75% of outflows)

tools.name: nsfr_calculator
tools.description: Calculate the Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) per BCBS 295. NSFR = ASF / RSF ≥ 100%. ASF and RSF factors per BCBS 295 Tables 1–2. Outputs compliant flag, ASF/RSF totals, surplus/(shortfall), and feeds Pillar 3 LIQ2 (T472). Verify factors against applicable jurisdiction rules (CRR2 EU; PRA UK). Synthetic data only.

asf_items.description: Available Stable Funding items with ASF factor

rsf_items.description: Required Stable Funding items with RSF factor

tools.name: leverage_ratio_calculator
tools.description: Calculate the Basel III leverage ratio per BCBS 360. LR = Tier 1 / Total Exposure Measure ≥ 3% (G-SIB leverage buffer additional per §12). Total exposure = on-BS + derivative (SA-CCR RC+PFE) + SFT + OBS (CCF-adjusted). Outputs ratio, minimum threshold, compliant flag. Feeds Pillar 3 KM1 row h (T472). Verify against CRR3/EU, PRA, or Fed SLR as applicable. Synthetic data only.

tools.name: pillar_3_disclosure_builder
tools.description: Assemble Basel III Pillar 3 disclosure tables (KM1, OV1, LIQ1, LIQ2) per BCBS 309/400. Consumes inputs from T201 (RWA), T469 (LCR), T470 (NSFR), T471 (leverage ratio). Final step in the bank-capital-liquidity composer chain. Verify row definitions against EBA ITS (EU) or PRA rules (UK) before use in actual disclosures. Synthetic data only.

tools.name: globe_etr_jurisdiction_calculator
tools.description: Calculate GloBE effective tax rate (ETR) per jurisdiction per OECD Pillar Two (Art. 5.1.1). ETR = Adjusted Covered Taxes / GloBE Income. Minimum 15%. SBIE deduction applied (Art. 5.3 transitional rates). Identifies jurisdictions below 15% for top-up tax (T474). ⚠ US-HQ groups exempt from IIR/UTPR per January 2026 OECD side-by-side package — do not apply IIR/UTPR to US-parented groups. Verify SBIE rates against current OECD Administrative Guidance. Synthetic data only.

jurisdictions.description: List of jurisdictions with GloBE income data

jur.description: ISO-3 jurisdiction code (e.g. DE, IE, SG)

assets.description: Qualifying tangible assets (m); used for SBIE

tools.name: topup_tax_qdmtt_calculator
tools.description: Compute Pillar Two top-up tax per jurisdiction (Art. 5.2.1) and allocate across QDMTT (Art. 11.3), IIR (Art. 2.1), and UTPR (Art. 2.4). ⚠ US-HQ groups are exempt from IIR and UTPR per the OECD January 2026 side-by-side package — set parent_hq='US' to apply exemption automatically. QDMTT exposure remains for all groups in jurisdictions with enacted QDMTT. Consumes T473 outputs. Feeds T476. Synthetic data only.

parent_hq.description: Parent HQ ISO-3 code — use 'US' to apply IIR/UTPR exemption

qdmtt_enacted.description: True if jurisdiction has enacted QDMTT

tools.name: pillar_two_safe_harbour_checker
tools.description: Check OECD Pillar Two transitional CbCR safe harbour eligibility per December 2022 agreed guidance. Three tests: (1) de minimis — revenue < €10M AND PBT < €1M; (2) simplified ETR — CbCR taxes/PBT ≥ threshold (15% FY2024–2025, 16% FY2026, 17% FY2027+); (3) routine profits — CbCR PBT ≤ SBIE. Also checks permanent safe harbour (GloBE ETR ≥ 15%). Transitional period expires after FY2026. ⚠ US-HQ exempt from IIR/UTPR (Jan 2026). Safe harbour jurisdictions still require GIR disclosure. Verify against full agreed guidance before filing reliance. Synthetic data only.

fy.description: Fiscal year — transitional safe harbours available 2024–2026 only

tools.name: gir_builder
tools.description: Assemble OECD GloBE Information Return (GIR) skeleton per GIR (January 2025), Annex A1. Covers Section 1 (MNE Group Information), Section 2 (Jurisdictional safe harbours and exclusions), Section 3 (GloBE Computations, top-up tax summary). Required for MNE groups with consolidated revenue ≥ €750M. First GIR filing: FY2024 groups, due 30 June 2026. Consumes T473 (ETR), T474 (top-up), T475 (safe harbours). ⚠ US-HQ groups exempt from IIR/UTPR per January 2026 OECD side-by-side package — set iir_utpr_exempt=true for US-parented jurisdictions. Safe harbour jurisdictions must still be disclosed in GIR. Actual XML filing requires authorised tax software. Synthetic data only.

tools.name: fatf_customer_risk_rating
tools.description: Score a customer across 6 FATF Recommendation 10/12 risk dimensions and return a composite AML risk tier (Low/Medium/High/Prohibited), required CDD level, and per-dimension breakdown. tools.name: check_tokenized_collateral_eligibility
tools.description: Classify tokenized assets for DTC/Fed eligibility, Basel HQLA tier (BCBS LCR paras 50–54), and transfer restrictions. Returns eligibility badge (DTC_ELIGIBLE / FED_ELIGIBLE_VERIFY / INELIGIBLE), HQLA tier (LEVEL_1 / LEVEL_2A / LEVEL_2B / NON_HQLA), haircut %, adjusted collateral value, and compliance flags including BCBS_SCO60_GROUP1A_NOTE for on-chain assets. tools.name: check_cash_leg_finality
tools.description: Validate the cash leg of a Canton settlement. Checks finality model (PFMI P8/P12): atomic_dvp_bound → FINALITY_ATOMIC (principal risk eliminated), standard_blockchain → warn on legal finality gap, traditional_wire → FAIL (Herstatt risk). GENIUS Act: cash+tbills+repo ≥ 95% and attestation required. MiCA: redemption_window T+2+ and EU jurisdiction → MICA_REDEMPTION_WINDOW_GAP. Depeg threshold >1% → DEPEG_THRESHOLD_WIDE. Verdict: PASS (atomic + reserve OK), CONDITIONAL (gaps, clear remediation), FAIL (critical).

finality_model.description: Cash-leg finality mechanism. Assessed against CPMI-IOSCO PFMI Principles 8 and 12.

jurisdiction.description: Regulatory jurisdiction. us → GENIUS Act check; eu → MiCA Title III check.

tools.name: validate_canton_dvp_atomicity
tools.description: Validate atomic DvP settlement on Canton. PFMI P12 compliance, finality model, Herstatt risk, unwind semantics. Generate counterparty-verifiable settlement attestation.

tools.name: calculate_repo_haircut
tools.description: Compute repo haircut, initial margin, and variation margin. Compare Canton 24/7 atomic valuation vs legacy weekend gap. Basel CRE22 + d349 SFT floors + GMRA.

tools.name: validate_canton_party_allowlist
tools.description: Screen parties against FATF Travel Rule requirements and AML/KYA checks for Canton Network onboarding. Generates a counterparty-verifiable allowlist attestation with FATF Recommendation 16 Travel Rule checks and Canton Daml party KYA validation.

tools.name: classify_digital_asset_regulatory
tools.description: Classify a tokenized asset under GENIUS Act, MiCA, MiFID II, and EU DLT Pilot Regime. Determines which regulatory framework(s) apply and what falls outside scope, with actionable next steps per framework.

tools.name: validate_pvp_settlement

tools.name: validate_tokenized_security_lifecycle

tools.name: mobilize_margin_collateral

tools.name: validate_fund_collateral

tools.name: validate_collateral_swap_eligibility

tools.name: compute_sa_im_margin

tools.name: score_fuzzy_match_calibration

tools.description: Walk the c2pa.ingredient parent-of tree and confirm hashed_uri bindings and nested manifest hashes chain back to the active manifest. Emits intact/broken verdict.

tools.name: pil_flavor_selector

tools.name: assess_agent_directory_publish_readiness
tools.description: Emit go/no-go directory publish-readiness for Web Bot Auth / Visa TAP / MC Agent Pay. Five boolean checks. ready = all true; gaps = failing keys list.

tools.name: check_dpa_gdpr_art28
tools.description: Checks a pasted DPA against GDPR Art 28(3) 12 mandatory processor clauses. Returns per-clause present/missing/weak verdicts and overall completeness score. Policy Mandate export available. Selection and analysis only, not legal advice. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/531-dpa-gdpr-art28-checker.html for interactive use.

dpa_text.description: Full text of the Data Processing Agreement to check

tools.name: score_clause_coverage
tools.description: Scored clause coverage of a pasted agreement against a named taxonomy (oneSaaS 52, Common Paper Language Library, GDPR Art 28). Returns coverage %, missing/partial clause lists, and maturity tier (Foundational/Developing/Proficient/Advanced). Selection and analysis only, not legal advice. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/532-clause-coverage-scorer.html for interactive use.

agreement_text.description: Full text of the agreement to score

taxonomy.description: Named clause taxonomy to score against

tools.name: validate_emir_trade_report
tools.description: Validate required fields of an EMIR Refit ISO 20022 auth.030 derivative trade report: action type, both counterparty LEIs (20-char ISO 17442), UTI, UPI, notional, currency, effective date, and asset class. Returns missing or malformed field list. Zero network, zero PII.

report.description: Decoded EMIR Refit auth.030 trade report fields

tools.name: check_emir_uti_completeness
tools.description: Validate EMIR Refit UTI format (ISO 23897, max 52 alphanumeric chars), generating-party LEI, and T+1 10:00 CET sharing timing. Caller supplies Unix timestamps for trade execution and UTI sharing. Returns format validity, deadline, and whether the T+1 SLA was met. Zero network, zero PII.

uti.description: Unique Trade Identifier (ISO 23897, max 52 alphanumeric chars)

generating_party.description: LEI of the party that generated the UTI

uti_shared_unix.description: Unix timestamp when UTI was shared with the other counterparty

tools.name: validate_emir_upi
tools.description: Validate EMIR Refit UPI format (ISO 4914, 12-char alphanumeric via ANNA DSB) and product classification consistency: asset class must be IR/CR/EQ/CO/FX and instrument type must be present. Returns format and classification verdict. Zero network, zero PII.

asset_class.description: EMIR asset class: IR, CR, EQ, CO, FX

tools.name: reconcile_emir_pairing
tools.description: Pair two counterparties EMIR Refit reports by UTI and reconcile the caller-supplied matching-field set (up to 148 fields) within configurable numeric tolerance. Returns paired status, matched fields count, and reconciliation break list. Zero network, zero PII.

report_a.description: Counterparty A trade report fields (must include uti)

report_b.description: Counterparty B trade report fields (must include uti)

tools.name: validate_emir_lifecycle_event
tools.description: Validate an EMIR Refit action type against the prior UTI state: New/Position on unreported, Modify/Correct/Valuation/Terminate/Error on open, Revive/Correct/Error on terminated. Returns validity verdict, allowed actions for the state, and rejection reason if invalid. Zero network, zero PII.

action_type.description: Proposed EMIR action type: New, Modify, Correct, Terminate, Valuation, Error, Position, Revive

prior_state.description: Prior reported state of the UTI: none, open, terminated

tools.name: run_emir_reporting_fit
tools.description: Grade a firm EMIR Refit reporting readiness across five dimensions: ISO 20022 cutover, UPI sourcing via ANNA DSB, UTI sharing SLA (10:00 CET T+1), reconciliation tolerance (148-field set), and lifecycle action controls. Returns A-F grade and gap list. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: validate_vida_einvoice_conformance
tools.description: Validate a structured e-invoice against EN 16931-1:2026 mandatory fields for ViDA (EU 2025/516) conformance: invoice number, date, ISO 4217 currency, seller name, buyer name, seller VAT ID, VAT breakdown with valid category code, and total with VAT. Returns conformant/vida_ready verdicts and list of missing fields. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: assess_vida_drr_reporting_obligation
tools.description: Assess whether a B2B transaction falls under ViDA Digital Reporting Requirements (DRR): check intra-EU cross-border B2B scope, calculate 10-day reporting deadline from invoice date, and verify data-element completeness (seller/buyer VAT IDs, transaction value). Returns drr_in_scope, reporting_deadline, and data_elements_ok. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: assess_vida_recapitulative_migration
tools.description: Assess readiness to migrate from EC Sales Lists (recapitulative statements) to ViDA Digital Reporting Requirements: check mandatory ESL fields (seller_vat_id, buyer_vat_id, reporting_period, supply_type), identify data gaps, and surface the applicable harmonization deadline (2030-07-01 or 2035-01-01 for pre-2024 domestic regimes). Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: classify_vida_platform_deemed_supplier
tools.description: Classify a digital platform as a ViDA deemed supplier under Art. 46a: short-term accommodation (≤30 consecutive nights) or intra-EU road passenger transport where the underlying supplier has no valid VAT ID causes VAT liability to transfer to the platform. Returns deemed_supplier verdict, sector_eligible, and applicable deadline (mandatory 2028-07-01, MS extension 2030-01-01). Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: route_vida_oss_registration
tools.description: Route a supply to the correct ViDA Single VAT Registration scheme: Union OSS (EU-established supplier, cross-border B2C or stock transfer within EU), Non-Union OSS (non-EU digital/deemed services to EU consumers), IOSS (non-EU goods ≤EUR 150 to EU consumers), or Domestic VAT. ViDA extends Union OSS from 2028-07-01. Returns recommended_scheme, scheme_rationale, and eligible_for_oss. Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: run_vida_readiness_diagnostic
tools.description: Scored ViDA readiness diagnostic across four dimensions: einvoice (EN 16931-1:2026 ready), drr (DRR reporting pipeline ready), platform (deemed-supplier assessed or not applicable), and oss (OSS/SVR scheme configured or not applicable). Returns readiness_score (0–100), gaps list, fully_ready boolean, and phased obligation timeline (2028-07-01 / 2030-07-01 / 2035-01-01). Zero network, zero PII.

tools.name: vc_issue
tools.description: Composes and signs a W3C Verifiable Credential 2.0 with an eddsa-jcs-2022 Data Integrity proof over a locally-generated, ephemeral did:key — this is local signing only, not authoritative issuance: no registry, CA, or issuer authority is contacted, nothing is persisted or registered anywhere, and the key exists only for this call. Returns the signed credential plus an OCG Standard section 23 vc-2.0 input-attestation block ready to embed in a chain's policy_parameters. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/544-vc2-issuance-composer.html for interactive use.

tools.name: sdjwt_issue
tools.description: Issues a Selective Disclosure JWT (RFC 9901) from a claims object, marking selected top-level claims as selectively disclosable via salted-hash digests in the _sd array, signed EdDSA over an ephemeral or supplied Ed25519 key. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/545-sdjwt-disclosure-workbench.html for interactive use, including the present mode (paste an SD-JWT, choose disclosures, optional KB-JWT holder binding).

tools.name: build_disclosure_manifest
tools.description: Builds a signed Merkle-rooted disclosure manifest from a digest list supplied by the caller. The agent supplies pre-computed path/size/digest entries; the worker never sees file contents. Returns the manifest object and Merkle root.

tools.name: verify_disclosure_inclusion
tools.description: Verifies a Merkle inclusion proof for a file digest against a disclosure manifest's root, given the manifest's entry list. Use to prove a specific document was part of a disclosed set at a given version.

manifest.description: The disclosure manifest to check against

path.description: Path of the entry to prove

digest.description: sha256:-prefixed digest of the file to prove

tools.name: fedwire_remediation_diff_receipt
tools.description: Diffs an original and a remediated Fedwire/CHIPS structured-address payment file (CSV) record-by-record against the November 2026 lint (lint_fedwire_structured_address rules), aligned by row position, and returns a remediation-evidence receipt binding both file digests and the rule-clearance delta (non-compliant count before minus after). Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/548-fedwire-remediation-diff-receipt.html for interactive use and the tamper-check digest verifier.

originalCsv.description: Raw CSV content of the pre-remediation payment file. Header: network,street_name,building_number,post_code,town_name,country,country_subdivision,address_lines

remediatedCsv.description: Raw CSV content of the post-remediation payment file, same row order as originalCsv

tools.name: compose_verification_failure_incident
tools.description: Composes and signs a verification-failure incident record (OCG Standard section 22.9 AR4SI-tiered) from session context, a failure classification, and an escalation target (fraud team, regulator, or insurer). Attests the declared record only, never detection quality or subject identity. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/549-verification-failure-incident-composer.html for interactive use.

tools.name: compose_c2pa_manifest_definition
tools.description: Composes a C2PA manifest DEFINITION from declared actions (c2pa.actions.v2, with digitalSourceType including trainedAlgorithmicMedia), ingredient declarations with client-side sha256 digests, a creative-work/EXIF-subset assertion, and an optional draft CAWG identity block. Runs the same structural validation as the house C2PA manifest validator. Does not sign and makes no Trust List claims — the output is a definition for external signing, not a signed manifest. Also exports a c2patool-compatible manifest-definition file for signing with your own certificate and tooling. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/550-c2pa-manifest-composer.html for interactive use.

tools.name: grade_lei_data_quality
tools.description: Grade a pasted GLEIF lei-records JSON record across six data-quality dimensions and return per-dimension grades plus a composite. Grades data quality of the record only — not creditworthiness, sanctions status, or entity legitimacy.

tools.name: build_redline_diff_receipt
tools.description: Diff a pasted original and revised text or markdown document and return a diff receipt (original/revised digests, hunk digests, diff algorithm, reviewer key, eddsa signature) plus a hash-chained per-hunk disposition chain binding a replayable accepted-text digest.

tools.name: check_acdc_said_structure
tools.description: Recompute the SAIDs of a pasted ACDC/vLEI credential JSON (top-level and nested a/e/r blocks) and compare against declared values. Cross-checks the schema SAID against a pinned GLEIF vLEI schema table. Structural integrity check only — not KERI chain-of-trust verification, not issuer authority, not revocation status. Local compute only: no state change, no keys held, nothing issued or registered.

tools.name: edit_workbook_table
tools.description: Loads CSV into a cell grid, recalculates formulas (SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/COUNT/COUNTIF/IF/AND/OR/NOT/ROUND/ABS/CONCAT/LEN/LEFT/RIGHT/TRIM/UPPER/LOWER/SUMIF), and digests a selected range into a manifest fragment for downstream verifiable-compute pipelines.

tools.name: iso20022_schema_subset_validate
tools.description: Validates a pain.001.001.09 or camt.053.001 ISO 20022 XML message against a hand-derived schema-subset table: structural presence, maxLength, pattern facets, IBAN mod-97, BIC format, ISO 4217/3166 code-list membership, and batch-total cross-checks (control sum vs. sum of amounts, transaction count, opening/closing balance reconciliation). Returns a structured error list. Subset validation, not full XSD conformance. Does not generate or transmit live payment messages.

tools.name: lint_otlp_genai_trace
tools.description: Validate an OTLP/JSON trace for structural correctness (resourceSpans/scopeSpans/spans shape, hex trace/span IDs, nanosecond timestamp ordering, parent-span references) and gen_ai attribute conformance against a pinned attribute snapshot. Returns per-span findings and a pass/violation/info summary.

tools.name: check_fips140_exposure
tools.description: Flag FIPS 140-2/140-1 validated modules in a pasted certificate inventory against the pinned NIST CMVP Historical-list transition date and summarize procurement exposure. Structural check over declared data only, not a live CMVP scan.

tools.name: compose_app_reimbursement_claim_evidence
tools.description: Composes a hash-chained, Merkle-rooted APP-fraud reimbursement claim-evidence bundle from a UK PSR (SD20) or EU IPR/PSD3-track checklist definition. Evidence composer only: binds what the PSP asserts, does not adjudicate liability or negligence.

tools.name: assess_cop_vop_scheme_readiness
tools.description: Scores a PSP's self-declared answers against the EPC VOP Scheme Rulebook (EPC218-23 v1.1) and Pay.UK Confirmation of Payee obligations, including a separately-tracked CoP-enhancement pilot checklist, and returns a gap report. Self-assessment only, not a scheme compliance determination.

tools.name: run_aiuc1_readiness_checkrun
tools.description: Runs the 23-step AIUC-1 automatable-control CHECKRUN (pillars A-F, 2026-Q1) and produces a hash-chained, Merkle-rooted readiness bundle prepared for AIUC-1 review.

control_evidence.description: Per-control attestation notes or sha256 evidence digests

tools.name: compose_technology_assisted_analysis_record
tools.description: Compose a PCAOB AS 1105 / AS 2301 technology-assisted-analysis documentation record from the auditor's description of the analysis performed, labeling internal (observed) vs external (asserted) tool provenance distinctly.

tools.name: check_engagement_documentation_gap
tools.description: Check an engagement-file inventory (presence flags only) against the PCAOB AS 1215 / QC 1000 documentation-element checklist. Returns a gap report listing missing elements with citations. Not a compliance determination.

tools.name: compose_iso20022_onchain_correspondence_receipt
tools.description: Compose a receipt asserting correspondence between an ISO 20022 payment message and an on-chain settlement leg, with an optional external-rail reference attachment. States the correspondence as asserted-by-mapping, not proven.

tools.name: pain001_compose
tools.description: Composes a multi-payment pain.001.001.09 credit-transfer initiation message from a debtor header and an array of payment rows, validating each field against the hand-derived schema-subset table (IBAN mod-97, BIC format, ISO 4217/3166 membership, decimal/date facets, Max35/Max140Text), then serializes canonical byte-stable XML and returns a preparation receipt (message digest, validation report digest, control sum, transaction count, prepared-not-transmitted flag). Subset validation, not full XSD conformance. Does not transmit live payments.

tools.name: camt053_reconcile
tools.description: Matches a camt.053 statement against a counterpart expectation set (EndToEndId exact match, then amount/date tolerance), returning a hash-chained reconciliation receipt and an exceptions list. Prepare/hash/receipt only, not a transmitted settlement.

tools.name: verify_otel_span_receipt
tools.description: Recomputes per-span digests and the parent-receipt chain over an OTLP/JSON trace against a span-receipt bundle, rebuilds the RFC 6962 Merkle root, and reports which spans are attested, unattested, or tampered.

bundle.description: Span-receipt bundle (span_receipts[] + trace_receipt) to verify against the trace

tools.name: compose_chargeback_evidence_bundle
tools.description: Runs the agent-payment dispute CHECKRUN across mandate/receipt, payment-protocol, and session/delivery evidence groups and produces a hash-chained, Merkle-rooted adjudication bundle. Verify-only: does not initiate, contest, route, or settle a chargeback.

evidence.description: Per-step attestation notes or sha256 evidence digests

tools.name: verify_ocg_receipt
tools.description: Recomputes an OCG receipt's execution_hash, verifies its eddsa-jcs-2022 signature (if present), and verifies RFC 6962 Merkle inclusion against an anchor binding or an uploaded checkpoint.

tools.name: calculate_regcc_availability
tools.description: Look up frozen-to-2030 Regulation CC (12 CFR 229) dollar thresholds and compute a funds-availability date from a deposit date and deposit type using configurable business-day counts. Not a substitute for the current Federal Register notice or 12 CFR 229 Subpart B.

tools.name: build_nydfs_part500_certification
tools.description: Builds a NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 annual certification/acknowledgment evidence bundle from a five-domain control checklist, computes April 15 filing-deadline math, and gates output on a senior-officer sign-off.

tools.name: check_export_fidelity
tools.description: Compares an exported chaingraph_export rendering (xlsx/csv/pdf/xbrl/vc) against the canonical OCG receipt it claims to come from: embedded-binding field compare plus byte-identical deterministic re-render.

tools.name: verify_workbook_roundtrip
tools.description: Compares a WB-2 Spreadsheet Input Manifest against pasted-back Excel ranges and returns a match/mismatch round-trip receipt naming every diverging cell.

tools.name: build_casefile_binder
tools.description: Builds a signed Merkle-rooted case-file binder manifest from a caller-supplied list of heterogeneous receipt references. The agent supplies {kind,ref_label,digest,verify_hint} entries; the worker never sees receipt contents. Returns the binder object and Merkle root.

engagement_label.description: Label for the engagement or matter

tools.name: verify_casefile_binder
tools.description: Verifies a case-file binder manifest's signature and recomputes its Merkle root over the caller-supplied entries list.

binder.description: The case-file binder manifest to verify

tools.name: build_evidence_handover_bundle
tools.description: Builds an offline zip bundle (self-contained verify.html, binder + receipt JSON files, README) from a case-file binder manifest and the receipts it references. The worker never sees receipt contents.

receipts.description: Optional list of receipt JSON objects the caller has in hand, matched to binder entries by digest

dnssec_chain_capture.description: Optional pre-captured DNSSEC chain (queried_name, resolver, captured_at, raw_chain_text) to include as corroboration. Never fetched or validated by this tool; verification is deferred to standard tooling such as delv.

tools.name: check_mt101_coexistence_readiness
tools.description: Evaluates Swift CBPR+ MT101 message-type retirement readiness (coexistence deadline 2026-11-14, FI-to-FI bulk/multiple payment initiation) from a caller-declared current message format (MT101 or pain.001v9) and a structural self-declared readiness checklist. Returns a deterministic ready/not-ready verdict, days_to_deadline computed from a fixed deadline constant and a caller-supplied as_of_date, and named readiness gaps. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/577-mt101-coexistence-readiness-diff.html for interactive use.

currentMessageFormat.description: Message format currently in production for FI-to-FI bulk/multiple payment initiation: "MT101" or "pain.001v9"

asOfDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to evaluate readiness as of

emitsPain001v9Bulk.description: True if the sender's system already emits pain.001v9 for bulk FI-to-FI (only relevant when currentMessageFormat is pain.001v9)

fallbackPathStaged.description: True if a fallback pain.001v9 path is staged (only relevant when currentMessageFormat is MT101)

correspondentConfirmedReceipt.description: True if the correspondent has confirmed it can receive pain.001v9 (only relevant when currentMessageFormat is MT101)

tools.name: ccp_margin_monitor_compare
tools.description: Compares CPMI-IOSCO PQD fields across a caller-selected FICC/ICE entity pair using the published Margin Monitor fixture dataset. A field not disclosed by an entity is reported unavailable, never interpolated. Comparison arithmetic only.

tools.name: verify_matter_export
tools.description: Recomputes a Helm matter manifest's manifest_digest, validates its shape, and reports each binding/deadline with a distinct status. Optionally checks a supplied bound artifact against a binding's subject_hash.

tools.name: build_dise_caption_category_matrix
tools.description: Builds a coverage matrix crosswalking trial-balance captions to DISE natural-expense-categories per ASU 2023-07, and flags any income-statement caption with no mapped rows. Also computes an optional dollar coverage percentage when trial balance amounts are supplied. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

captions.description: Entity income statement captions, optionally with total balances

mappings.description: TB caption to DISE category mapping rows

tools.name: analyze_dise_readiness_gaps
tools.description: Classifies every required-DISE-category by income-statement-caption cell as no_coverage, partial_coverage or full_coverage from a pasted coverage matrix, ranks the gaps by materiality or category, and returns a plain-English remediation note for each. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

required_categories.description: Categories the entity has determined it must be able to report separately

captions.description: Income statement captions in scope, optionally with total balances

coverage_rows.description: Caption plus category coverage rows from the matrix builder

threshold_pct.description: Dollar coverage percentage at or above which a caption counts as fully mapped. Default 95.

tools.name: calc_taxes_paid_jurisdiction_threshold
tools.description: Computes each jurisdiction's share of total income taxes paid net of refunds received and flags which jurisdictions reach the ASU 2023-09 individual-disaggregation threshold of 5 percent, comparing absolute values on both sides. Also returns the federal, state and foreign subtotals required regardless of threshold. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

jurisdictions.description: Rows of jurisdiction, tier and income taxes paid net of refunds received

declared_total.description: Total income taxes paid net of refunds, used as the denominator when supplied

tools.name: sequence_disclosure_effective_dates
tools.description: Returns which tracked FASB Accounting Standards Updates bind for a given fiscal year end and SEC filer status, separating the annual requirement from the interim requirement and naming each Update's first affected period for the entity's fiscal calendar. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII.

fiscal_year_end.description: Last day of the fiscal year being assessed, as YYYY-MM-DD

fiscal_year_start_override.description: First day of that fiscal year, for 52 or 53 week filers whose year start is not a fixed calendar date

filer_status.description: SEC filer status. All four are public business entities.

tools.name: verify_ics23_proof
tools.description: Verifies an ICS23 existence or non-existence Merkle proof against a commitment root and one of three pinned ProofSpec presets (iavl, tendermint, smt), entirely offline in the browser. Returns a PASS or FAIL verdict and names the specific check that failed.

tools.name: compute_m3p_monthly_cap
tools.description: Recomputes the CMS Medicare Prescription Payment Plan maximum monthly cap under 42 CFR 423.137(c)(1)(i)/(ii) from caller-declared numerator and months-remaining inputs, verified by exhaustive enumeration over the full declared 4,830,023-state domain. Returns the cap in cents and dollars, or a named domain-rejection reason. Use when an agent needs the CMS-formula monthly cap for a Medicare Part D enrollee participating in the payment plan.

tools.name: calculate_naic_clo_rbc_factor
tools.description: Recomputes NAIC Life RBC per-tranche CLO/CBO/CDO capital charges against the LR002 Column (2) factor grid (Proposal 2026-12-IRE), including the BSL thin-tranche 11.77% surcharge for designation 2.C or below at <=4% thickness. Sums per-tranche requirements into a portfolio total. Verify-only.

tools.name: verify_summa_mst_inclusion
tools.description: Verifies a Merkle-sum-tree inclusion proof for one leaf against a published root: recomputes both the hash chain and the sum chain independently, and rejects negative or over-bound balances anywhere in the path (the Maxwell 2022/043 'broken MST' hazard). Verify-only -- never a solvency claim.

tools.name: aggregate_summa_mst_liabilities
tools.description: Builds a SHA-256 Merkle-sum-tree over up to 16 (id, balance) leaves and emits the root commitment plus every leaf's inclusion proof, after rejecting negative or over-bound balances on the input side. Verify-only.

leaves.description: Array of {id, balance} (balance as a decimal string), 1-16 entries.

tools.name: reanchor_receipt_pq
tools.description: Client-side only tool — never MCP-invocable. Key generation and signing must happen in the caller's own browser tab; this tool never receives or returns a private key, so it cannot be exposed as a remote MCP tool call.

tools.name: verify_vcjcs_envelope
tools.description: Independently recomputes the eddsa-jcs-2022 signature and every embedded execution_hash of a VC-JCS-wrapped export, entirely offline.

tools.name: verify_c2sp_tlog_checkpoint
tools.description: Verifies a C2SP checkpoint signed note, its witness cosignature quorum against a tlog-policy trust policy, and an RFC 6962 inclusion proof against the checkpoint root. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII.

policy.description: C2SP tlog-policy text naming the log and witness keys and the quorum rule

proof.description: RFC 6962 inclusion proof: leaf value, leaf index, bottom-up sibling path

tile_path.description: Optional tlog-tiles path for the tile the leaf was read from

tools.name: analyze_gir_data_point_completeness
tools.description: Maps a filer-declared data inventory against the GloBE Information Return (January 2025) Annex A1 data-point structure and reports which points are populated, partial, missing, or not applicable, naming the condition behind every conditional point. Returns a coverage count over the declared inventory. Does not compose a GIR, does not render GIR XML, and does not evaluate any amount.

declared_inventory.description: [{id, status}] with status populated, partial or missing

declared_facts.description: Boolean facts that switch conditional data points on

tools.name: classify_pillar_two_side_by_side_scope
tools.description: Classifies a declared MNE group and jurisdiction fact pattern against the Qualified SbS Regime and Qualified UPE Regime conditions in Chapter 5 of the OECD Side-by-Side Package (Inclusive Framework, approved 5 January 2026). Returns a per-condition verdict naming the governing condition, and sets manual_review_required whenever a fact the rule needs is absent, rather than defaulting or inferring it. Thresholds, effective dates and Central Record listings are declared versioned inputs. Classifies the declared fact pattern only: it does not determine whether any group falls inside or outside scope, and it is not tax advice.

rule_parameters.description: Declared versioned thresholds, dates and Central Record listings

group_facts.description: UPE jurisdiction, fiscal year commencement, and the two election flags

jurisdiction_facts.description: Declared facts about the UPE jurisdiction's domestic and worldwide tax systems

tools.name: verify_x402_payment_envelope
tools.description: Checks an x402 PaymentPayload envelope's header well-formedness, signature structure, and consistency against an optional PaymentRequirements body, entirely offline.

tools.name: verify_vpsf_claim_composite
tools.description: Structurally verifies an x402 VPSF Claim Algebra composite (conjunction/implication/aggregation/selective_disclosure/revocation) and its component Payment Claims against draft-vauban-x402-vpsf-algebra-01. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII. Does not verify cryptographic evidence (STARK proofs, signatures) attached to component claims.

composite.description: VPSF operator composite over the claims

tools.name: emit_x402_spendevidence_vpsf_claims
tools.description: Renders an x402_spend_evidence pack (from the x402-spend-evidence chain) as a VPSF SettlementReceipt + DelegationGrant claim pair with a conjunction composite, JCS-hashed per draft-vauban-x402-vpsf-algebra-01. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII. Refuses to emit when the source pack does not itself establish a valid, unreplayed, in-window authorization.

tools.name: validate_pm_artifact
tools.description: Validates one or more pasted pm:* (prediction/event-market provenance) OpenChainGraph artifacts against the registered SPEC.md §5.1 schema, recomputes execution_hash client-side via the canonical _hash.mjs algorithm, and reports the chain.parent_hashes linkage. Deterministic rule-based checks only — no oracle logic.

artifact_json.description: A single pm:* artifact JSON object, or a JSON array of them

tools.name: cbpr_sr2026_address_preflight
tools.description: Classify CBPR+ payment message postal addresses (debtor, creditor, debtor agent, creditor agent, intermediary agents) as structured, hybrid, or unstructured per Swift CBPR+ SR2026 guidance, and flag which will be hard-rejected at CBPR+ network level from 14 November 2026. camt.052/053/054/025/060 and admi.024 are exempt. Hybrid = Town Name + Country plus up to 2 Address Lines of up to 70 characters. Agents identified by BIC only need no postal address. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/632-cbpr-sr2026-address-preflight.html for interactive use.

tools.name: validate_dora_roi_xbrl_csv_package
tools.description: Validates a prepared DORA Register of Information xBRL-CSV package (report.json, FilingIndicators.csv, parameters.csv, archive filename, table CSVs) against the EBA DPM 4.0 filing rules documented in the CSSF NCA submission guide: exact report.json documentType/extends content, lowercase FilingIndicators booleans, parameters.csv field order and decimalsMonetary=-3, archive naming convention, and representative per-table mandatory-column and LEI-format/checksum checks. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII, zero network (no GLEIF lookup). Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/633-dora-roi-xbrl-csv-validator.html for interactive use.

tools.name: calculate_cass15_safeguarding_reconciliation
tools.description: Computes the UK CASS 15.8 daily safeguarding reconciliation: per-customer individual balance build-up floored at zero with no cross-customer netting (15.8.31R/15.8.30R), unallocated funds included in the requirement until allocated (15.8.30R(2)), safeguarding resource summed across the four CASS 15.8.26R component types, shortfall/excess/reconciled verdict computed independently per currency (no FX conversion), and the same-day rectification timing note (15.8.50R). Documented-non-standard-method toggle per 15.8.37R. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/634-cass15-safeguarding-reconciliation-calc.html for interactive use.

tools.name: check_emir3_active_account_requirement
tools.description: Determines an EU counterparty's EMIR Article 7a Active Account Requirement posture: in-scope gate (EUR/PLN IRD, EUR STIR clearing-threshold exceedance), the active-account obligation (Art 7a(1)), the EUR 6 billion representativeness threshold and five-cleared-trades-per-subcategory annual-average test (Art 7a(4)), and the RTS Article 10 reporting deadline (last day of January/July). Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/635-emir3-active-account-requirement-checker.html for interactive use.

tools.name: calculate_basel_sma_operational_risk_capital
tools.description: Computes Basel Standardised Measurement Approach operational risk capital: Business Indicator (BI = ILDC+SC+FC per OPE25.5), Business Indicator Component via the marginal 12/15/18% bucket table (OPE25.7), Loss Component (15x average annual losses over 10 years, OPE25.8), Internal Loss Multiplier (ILM = ln(e-1+(LC/BIC)^0.8), OPE25.8), Operational Risk Capital (ORC=BICxILM) and RWA (12.5xORC), with a jurisdiction toggle for the EU/UK national-discretion ILM=1 fix (OPE25.11). Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/636-basel-sma-oprisk-calculator.html for interactive use.

tools.name: calculate_frtb_sa_sbm_capital
tools.description: Computes FRTB Standardised Approach sensitivities-based-method delta capital for a synthetic portfolio across GIRR, FX and Equity risk classes: risk weights per MAR21 Tables 1/9/10, intra-bucket correlations (GIRR tenor-decay formula, equity bucket-group percentages), cross-bucket gamma parameters, and the three correlation scenarios (medium/high x1.25 capped 100%/low per the 2x-100% floor formula), reporting the maximum total per MAR21.7. Demo/educational, delta-only, three risk classes only. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/637-frtb-sa-sbm-calculator.html for interactive use.

tools.name: map_uk_ctp_exposure
tools.description: Maps a firm's material/important business services onto the four UK-designated Critical Third Parties (Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL, Google Cloud EMEA Limited, Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited, Oracle Corporation UK Limited; designated effective 13 Jul 2026 per HM Treasury) via legal-entity-exact matching, flags indirect chain exposure via sub-outsourcing/reseller keyword detection, computes HHI provider concentration, and splits CTP-owed duties (PRA/FCA PS16/24-PS24/16 Fundamental Rules 1-6) from firm-retained duties (SS2/21 outsourcing risk assessment, exit strategy, operational-resilience impact tolerances) which designation does not reduce. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/638-uk-ctp-exposure-mapper.html for interactive use.

tools.name: estimate_amla_direct_supervision_eligibility
tools.description: Estimates whether a credit institution, financial institution, or CASP clears the AMLAR (Regulation EU 2024/1620) Art. 12(1) six-Member-State activity gate for the 2027 AMLA direct-supervision selection round: establishment-based presence always counts, freedom-to-provide-services presence counts only where per-Member-State activity is material (more than 20,000 customers OR more than EUR 50 million annual transaction volume, OR logic), home Member State always counts. Reports gate-margin detail and the selection timeline (selection begins 1 Jul 2027, supervision begins 1 Jan 2028), and discloses that final selection additionally requires AMLA residual-risk-profile ranking under Art. 13, not computable client-side. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/639-amla-direct-supervision-eligibility-estimator.html for interactive use.

tools.name: lookup_travel_rule_corridor_status
tools.description: Looks up an origin/destination jurisdiction pair for crypto Travel Rule corridor status using an editable reference set keyed to the FATF Seventh Targeted Update (16 Jul 2026: 83 percent of 109 surveyed jurisdictions have legislation in force, 11 in progress, 60 percent of in-force jurisdictions have zero enforcement action; Argentina, Cambodia, Colombia, and Vietnam are named as having no framework). Reports BOTH-LIVE / ONE-SIDED sunrise asymmetry / NEITHER-LIVE / OUT-OF-SCOPE (self-hosted wallet counterparty) verdicts, applies each leg's numeric threshold (EU TFR zero-threshold since 30 Dec 2024 with self-hosted ownership verification above EUR 1,000) to the entered amount to select a full vs reduced required-field tier, and surfaces the enforcement-gap flag beside legislation status. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/640-travel-rule-sunrise-matrix.html for interactive use.

tools.name: model_sanctions_alert_economics
tools.description: Models the annualized cost of a sanctions/AML screening program's alert volume: computes alerts per year from screened volume and alert rate, analyst hours from an L1-triage plus L2-escalation tier split (each with its own handle time), annualized cost from a loaded analyst rate, true positives from the false-positive rate, and cost per true positive. Produces a threshold-tuning sensitivity curve (alert-rate deltas to cost deltas) and displays the OFAC IEEPA statutory maximum civil penalty (2026: USD 377,700 per violation) as a labelled context anchor never multiplied into the cost arithmetic. Companion to tool 517 (match-score calibration) for economics rather than matching logic. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/641-sanctions-alert-economics-modeler.html for interactive use.

tools.name: verify_plain_text_accounting_journal
tools.description: Parses a plain-text-accounting (hledger/Beancount-style) journal, validates double-entry balance and inline balance assertions, computes an RFC 6962 Merkle root over transactions, and returns an AINumbers Evidence Envelope v0.1 receipt with execution_hash. Use when an agent needs to independently verify a synthetic accounting journal's arithmetic integrity.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_docx_markdown
tools.description: Extracts the text layer of a PDF and converts it to Markdown and DOCX, with font-size-based heading detection, bullet/ordinal list detection, and best-effort geometric tables. Reports pages with no text layer rather than returning silent empty output. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/643-pdf-to-docx-markdown-converter.html for interactive use.

tools.name: compare_agent_spend_control_layers
tools.description: Compare agent spend-control mechanisms across platforms (Locus agent connections, Ramp user-delegation and standalone agents) and protocols (AP2 mandates, x402, Visa VIC token scope, Mastercard agentic tokens) on identity model, budget granularity, attenuation rule, expiry, revocation path, audit attribution, and receipt artifact. Read-only local lookup over a dated, cited reference snapshot; no state change, no keys held, nothing sent or registered anywhere.

layers.description: Subset of layer ids to include.

tools.name: compute_derivatives_margin_workbench
tools.description: Computes event-market linear PnL, margin health against a caller-declared venue margin model, and two-position correlation-VaR cross-margin efficiency. Use when an agent needs margin buffer, liquidation price, leverage, or cross-margin capital efficiency for a declared derivatives position, without assuming any one venue's margin mechanics.

tools.name: compute_interest_accrual_recompute
tools.description: Recomputes per-day interest accrual over a caller-declared day-count/compounding convention and diffs the cumulative total against the core's own posted accrual/interest-paid ledger entries. Returns MATCHES, DIVERGES with the first divergent date and cent amount, or INDETERMINATE. Use when an agent needs an independent recompute-and-receipt of a core's interest accrual math, not an audit of the core itself.

tools.name: compute_odnsf_fee_recompute
tools.description: Recomputes overdraft and NSF fee events from a posted-transaction ledger under a declared posting-order policy and fee schedule, diffed against core-charged fees. Independent recompute and receipt, not a core alternative or vendor audit.

fee_schedule.description: Declared fee amounts, caps, dedup and extended-overdrawn terms

core_charged_fees.description: What the core actually charged, to diff against

tools.name: compute_apy_earned_recompute
tools.description: Recomputes the periodic-statement APY-earned from caller-declared interest earned, average daily balance (direct or days-weighted from balance spans) and days in period, then diffs it against the disclosed figure within a declared accuracy band. Returns MATCHES, DIVERGES with the exact difference, or INDETERMINATE. Use when an agent needs an independent recompute-and-receipt of a disclosed periodic-statement yield, not an audit of the core itself.

tools.name: compute_loan_servicing_waterfall_recompute
tools.description: Recomputes a single loan payment's application across caller-declared buckets under the note's own bucket application order, and diffs the result against the core's actual applied breakdown.

tools.name: compute_gl_tieout_recompute
tools.description: Recomputes subledger-to-GL tie-out totals under a caller-declared chart-of-accounts mapping, either against a reported trial balance (single-source mode) or diffed between two full sources for conversion balancing (diff mode), returning MATCHES, DIVERGES (per-account-code deltas), or INDETERMINATE.

tools.name: a2a_liquidity_simulator
tools.description: Model intraday cash flow and prefunding requirements across FedNow, RTP, ACH, SEPA Instant, PIX, and UPI. Single and multi-rail simulation with overdraft risk, opportunity cost, and routing waterfall. Client-side, zero PII. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/a2a-liquidity-simulator.html for interactive use.

tools.name: validate_ap2_mandate_chain
tools.description: Validates AP2 v0.2 Intent→Cart→Payment mandate chains: signature-chain integrity, scope consistency, TTL/expiry, over-spend, HNP flow flags.

tools.name: simulate_spend_policy
tools.description: Simulates N synthetic agent transactions against a spend policy definition. Returns violation counts, scope-creep ratio, bypass-path detection, HNP authorization gaps, and full transaction-level log.

tools.name: model_x402_settlement
tools.description: Models settlement cost and finality across x402, Stripe USDC on Base, card, ACH, and SWIFT for agent-initiated payments.

tools.name: check_agent_attestation
tools.description: Validates AI agent identity credentials and delegated-authority chains against KYA-OS (DIF Trusted AI Agents WG). Checks chain integrity, scope limits, validity windows, depth cap, EU AI Act posture.

tools.name: precheck_reserve_attestation
tools.description: Pre-checks stablecoin reserves against GENIUS Act (S.394) requirements: 1:1 coverage, asset eligibility, AICPA 2025 attestation readiness.

tools.name: classify_dora_incident
tools.description: Classifies an ICT-related incident under DORA Articles 19–23. Returns major/non-major determination, qualifying criteria, and the reporting clock (4h initial, 72h intermediate, 1-month final).

tools.name: score_aml_typologies
tools.description: Scores a synthetic transaction graph against six AML typology detectors. Returns per-transaction risk scores, typology hit counts, account risk profiles, and SAR narrative skeleton.

tools.name: simulate_vop_matching
tools.description: Batch VoP IBAN-name match across synthetic payee records. Returns per-record MATCH/CLOSE_MATCH/NO_MATCH classification, Jaro-Winkler similarity scores, match-rate summary, and FP/FN trade-off curve.

tools.name: validate_acp_checkout
tools.description: Validates ACP CheckoutRequest and CheckoutResponse payloads. Checks required fields, SPT structure, signature format, amount precision, currency codes, and agent-commerce-specific fields per the OpenAI/Stripe ACP specification.

tools.name: assess_psd3_readiness
tools.description: Assesses PSD3/PSR readiness across key compliance domains and returns a structured readiness verdict with gap analysis.

tools.name: simulate_agent_spend_policy
tools.description: Builds a deterministic Agent Guardrail Mandate skeleton from declared spend caps, MCC allowlist/blocklist, velocity rules, time windows, and approval thresholds. Stage 1 of the Agentic Policy Chain. The browser page additionally runs an interactive randomized synthetic-transaction simulator against the mandate for exploration; that non-deterministic step is a UI feature only and is not part of this server artifact's hashed output. Zero PII, client-side compute in the browser tool, deterministic server compute for MCP callers.

tools.name: score_mcp_server_readiness
tools.description: Rolls up caller-supplied yes/partial/no answers across six MCP ship-readiness sections (tool definitions, server.json/registry, OAuth 2.1, transport security, tool-poisoning hygiene, spec-revision compliance) into an overall 0-100 score and a prioritized gap list. Stage 4 (terminal) of the Agentic Policy Chain. Self-reported rollup; validate each weak section with its own deep-dive tool. Deterministic, zero PII.

tools.name: select_agentic_checkout_protocol
tools.description: Scores ACP, UCP, x402, and Visa TAP against platform profile (buyer type, AOV, geography, stack capabilities) and returns a ranked protocol recommendation with fit scores. Node 1 of 3 in the Agentic Checkout Chain.

tools.name: audit_acp_ucp_product_feed
tools.description: Validates product/checkout/mandate JSON payloads against ACP or UCP field schemas (5 schema arrays). Identifies missing required fields, type mismatches, and unknown fields. Node 2 of 3 in the Agentic Checkout Chain.

tools.name: build_agent_traffic_policy
tools.description: Builds a policy mandate governing accepted AI agent types, identity verification level, velocity and value caps, payment rails, refund posture, retry policy, and blocking rules. Exports an agent-readable instructions block and a §4 hash-anchored artifact. Node 3 of 3 in the Agentic Checkout Chain.

tools.name: compare_agentic_rail_protocols
tools.description: Compares AP2, ACP, x402, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agentic Token, and Tempo MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) across 8 dimensions (backer, artifact, signing, scope, rail, identity, audit, status) and 6 agentic scenarios. Root node of the Agentic Rail Chain: routing_policy output determines Branch A (AP2/card) or Branch B (A2A/x402). Promoted from T276.

tools.name: inspect_visa_trusted_agent_protocol
tools.description: Parses and scores Visa TAP Signature-Input / Signature header pairs (RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures). Runs a 5-question TAP Readiness Assessment. Branch A, node 2 of the Agentic Rail Chain. Promoted from T286.

tools.name: run_mcp_deployability_diagnostic
tools.description: 12-question scored diagnostic: graded A–F across tool definitions & schemas, transport & auth, security hygiene, and operations. Single-node ChainGraph (chain_depth: 0). Promoted from guides/mcp-server-deployability-diagnostic.html.

tools.name: validate_tempo_zone_disclosure
tools.description: Maps a Tempo Zone's party-visibility model (operator-sees-all / users-see-own / outsiders-see-ZK-proofs) against AML/audit/regulator disclosure obligations. Confirms TIP-403 freeze/allowlist propagates cross-zone. Issues a privacy-and-auditability attestation for the board/regulator. Verdict: FULL_ATTESTATION / PARTIAL_ATTESTATION / INSUFFICIENT. ISO 20022 pacs.008-subset artifact. Zones live June 2026; payroll/treasury first use case.

tools.name: map_tempo_settlement
tools.description: Binds an ACP / Visa TAP / ISO 20022 checkout to a TIP-20 settlement. Maps the 32-byte Tempo memo → ISO 20022 remittance_information, sender/receiver → debtor/creditor (with optional LEI), and normalises an on-chain Tempo tx into the AP2 artifact envelope. The canonical OCG v0.3 pacs.008-subset tool for Tempo: instructs the bilateral settlement receipt that agents and merchants both verify via execution_hash. W-D terminal node.

tools.name: model_arc_cpn_economics
tools.description: Models Circle Payments Network (CPN) corridor economics vs SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and card rails. Returns per-transaction savings, annual savings, basis points, and a CFO settlement memo. Grounded in industry-standard fee benchmarks and Circle Arc documentation.

tools.name: model_arc_stablefx_rfq
tools.description: Models Arc StableFX RFQ spread savings vs current FX provider and quantifies Herstatt principal risk elimination. Grounded in PFMI P12, BIS settlement risk literature, and Circle Arc StableFX documentation. Returns spread savings, Herstatt exposure, and a settlement comparison memo.

tools.name: lint_arc_xreserve_config
tools.description: Lints an Arc xReserve reserve configuration for GENIUS Act §4 1:1 eligible-asset requirements, MiCA Art. 54 EMT reserve rules, and Arc xReserve composition guidelines. Returns A–F graded checks with remediation guidance. Not legal advice.

tools.name: model_arc_paymaster_economics
tools.description: Models Circle Paymaster USDC-as-gas economics on Arc vs native ETH gas on Ethereum for ERC-4337 UserOperations. Returns per-UserOperation costs, monthly and annual savings, sponsorship break-even, and CFO memo. Grounded in ERC-4337 spec and Circle Arc Paymaster documentation.

tools.name: validate_cctp_v2_transfer
tools.description: Validates a CCTP v2 cross-chain USDC transfer for domain pair eligibility, Fast Transfer finality risk, Hook payload safety, and CCTP v1 sunset migration status. Returns A–F graded checks with remediation guidance. Grounded in Circle CCTP v2 documentation.

tools.name: run_treasury_clearing_fit
tools.description: 12-question A-F readiness diagnostic for the SEC US Treasury clearing mandate (cash Dec 31 2026 / repo Jun 30 2027). Grades scope, access, margin capacity, capital, ops/docs, and liquidity; routes to the right treasury-clearing chain and emits a remediation checklist.

tools.name: model_clearing_access_economics
tools.description: Selects and costs the FICC access model - Direct vs Sponsored (done-with) vs Sponsored/Agent (done-away) - across cost, execution-access, margin/netting efficiency, and ops. Recommends a model with a CFO memo. Educational economics; not clearing advice.

tools.name: estimate_ficc_margin_netting
tools.description: DV01-bucket VaR proxy of the FICC VaR-based margin (VBM), the netting benefit of central vs bilateral clearing, cash-vs-repo cross-product netting, and the done-away uplift. Educational proxy - not the official FICC VBM calculator.

tools.name: estimate_cross_margin_benefit
tools.description: Estimates the initial-margin reduction from the FICC-CME cross-margining arrangement (customer expansion per SEC notice published 2025-12-22) by offsetting UST cash/repo DV01 against CME Treasury/SOFR futures DV01. Educational proxy.

tools.name: run_digital_trade_fit
tools.description: 12-question A–F readiness diagnostic for digital trade / electronic trade documents (MLETR). Grades corridor legality, document digitisation, platform connectivity, trade-rule basis (eUCP/URDTT), financing, and AML/TBML controls; routes to the right chain and emits a remediation checklist.

tools.name: assess_mica_casp_readiness
tools.description: Scores readiness for MiCA CASP authorization (Arts 59-63): service-permission scope, governance/fit-and-proper, custody segregation, complaints/conflicts, ICT/DORA overlap. Gap score + Art 60/62 application-pack outline.

tools.name: calculate_mica_own_funds
tools.description: Computes MiCA Art 67 required own funds = higher of Annex IV permanent minimum (€50k advisory / €125k trading-platform / €150k custody-exchange) or ¼ fixed overheads. Checks CET1/insurance form eligibility.

tools.name: lint_crypto_asset_whitepaper
tools.description: Validates Art 6/8 whitepaper: Annex I section completeness + iXBRL/XHTML well-formedness + ESMA MiCA taxonomy structural conformance (ITS 2024/2984). Section gaps + non-compliance-register risk.

tools.name: assess_mar_crypto_surveillance
tools.description: Scores market-abuse arrangements (Arts 86-92 + Dec-2024 RTS): PPAET (prevention/detection), STOR templates, insider lists, manipulation-pattern config on synthetic order batches. Readiness grade + STOR-template completeness.

tools.name: validate_tfr_travel_rule_batch
tools.description: Validates originator/beneficiary field completeness on synthetic/hashed transfer batches (self-/cross-CASP + unhosted-wallet branches) per TFR recast Reg. (EU) 2023/1113. Batch conformance + Merkle root. No real PII.

tools.name: scope_mica_token_and_service
tools.description: Disambiguation router classifying a case as ART/EMT-issuer (delegated to existing stablecoin-compliance chains) vs CASP-service (MiCA chains). Prevents Title III/IV vs Title V overlap; packages the MiCA suite.

tools.name: reconcile_mpp_subscription
tools.description: Reconciles executed MPP subscription/streaming draws against the authorized mandate envelope. Checks per-cycle caps, cumulative caps, expiry/revocation, and produces a draw-set commitment for Merkle verification. Cites MPP session semantics.

tools.name: model_tempo_gas_economics
tools.description: Models Tempo enshrined-AMM gas cost across fee-stablecoin mix with server-paid sponsorship, vs card/SWIFT/ACH baselines. Returns blended gas cost, sponsorship break-even, and annual savings. Distinct from Arc ERC-4337 Paymaster.

tools.name: validate_canton_selective_disclosure
tools.description: Validates a Canton DvP privacy partition: each counterparty sees only its own leg, both views reconcile to one atomic commitment, no cross-leg field leakage. Inputs are structural (field names/roles), never party data — zero PII.

tools.name: validate_dtc_tokenized_treasury
tools.description: Validates DTCC/ComposerX tokenized U.S. Treasury: DTC custody linkage, Fed eligibility, ComposerX DAML lifecycle coverage (issuance/corporate-actions/redemption), and programmable-collateral-reuse eligibility. DTC/UST-specific; not generic lifecycle.

tools.name: score_partner_stablecoin_readiness
tools.description: Scores a non-USD stablecoin issuer against Circle Partner Stablecoin standards: technical/operational, reserve-management, and risk-management. Returns A–F grade, gap list, and eligibility flag. Distinct from USDC issuer / GENIUS Act path.

tools.name: route_partner_stablecoin_jurisdiction
tools.description: Routes each Arc corridor leg to its home regulatory regime (EURC→MiCA EMT, JPYC→JP FSA, BRLA→BCB, MXNB→CNBV, AUDF→ASIC, PHPC→BSP, QCAD→FINTRAC, ZARU→SARB). Flags disclosure gaps and emits PvP (511) + Travel-Rule (art-104) handoffs. No FX economics.

tools.name: verify_dscsa_transaction_statement
tools.description: Verify DSCSA T3 set completeness, validate GS1 SGTIN, map EPCIS 2.0 event type. DSCSA §582.

tools.name: verify_saleable_return
tools.description: Match returned SGTIN+lot to original transaction hash. DSCSA §582(c)(4)(D).

tools.name: assess_suspect_product_status
tools.description: Determine suspect vs illegitimate product status and required DSCSA §582(h) actions.

tools.name: validate_dpp_data_carrier
tools.description: Validate DPP required data elements against CIRPASS-2 Core Ontology and GS1 Digital Link carrier type. EU ESPR.

tools.name: build_product_lineage
tools.description: Build cradle-to-gate supplier lineage with hash-only claims and carbon aggregation. EU ESPR DPP.

tools.name: verify_product_authenticity
tools.description: Verify lineage hashes chain to claimed root and ownership transfers are continuous.

tools.name: validate_fsma204_cte
tools.description: Validate required KDEs for FSMA 204 CTE types per the FDA Food Traceability List.

tools.name: link_traceability_lot_code
tools.description: Link TLCs across FSMA 204 CTEs, detect breaks, flag transformation new-lot events.

tools.name: resolve_recall_trace
tools.description: One-up/one-back trace from contaminated TLC for FDA 24-hour recall spreadsheet. FSMA 204.

tools.name: anchor_document_integrity
tools.description: Bind document SHA-256 + claimed timestamp as eIDAS Art.41 / RFC 3161-aligned electronic timestamp.

tools.name: verify_timestamp_attestation
tools.description: Verify document integrity anchor: hash match, timestamp consistency, algorithm match.

tools.name: validate_cyclonedx_sbom
tools.description: Validate a CycloneDX SBOM (bomFormat, specVersion, component name/version/purl, top-level dependencies) against the EU CRA Annex I machine-readable SBOM requirement. Feeds the SLSA provenance verifier (art-136). CRA SBOM mandate; full applicability 11 Dec 2027.

tools.name: verify_slsa_provenance
tools.description: Verify an in-toto SLSA provenance statement: _type (in-toto.io/Statement), predicateType (slsa.dev/provenance), subject SHA-256 digest match, builder.id present, and claimed build level (0–3). Zero network. Node 2 of sbom-provenance-attestation chain (art-135→136→137).

tools.name: validate_openvex_statement
tools.description: Validate an OpenVEX document: @context from openvex.dev, each statement has vulnerability, products[], valid status (not_affected/affected/fixed/under_investigation), and justification when status=not_affected. Zero network. Terminal node of sbom-provenance-attestation chain (art-135→136→137).

tools.name: validate_spdx_sbom
tools.description: Validate an SPDX SBOM (spdxVersion 2.x/3.x, SPDXID, package name/versionInfo/downloadLocation or purl externalRef, relationships) against the EU CRA Annex I machine-readable SBOM requirement. Feeds CRA Annex I completeness checker (art-139). Full applicability 11 Dec 2027.

tools.name: check_cra_annex1_completeness
tools.description: Check EU CRA (Regulation 2024/2847) Annex I essential requirements: sbom_present, sbom_machine_readable, top_level_deps_covered, vuln_handling_policy_present, secure_by_default, and conformity_route (self_assessment/eu_type_examination/full_quality_assurance). Returns gaps list. Second node of cra-product-conformance chain (art-138→139→140). Full applicability 11 Dec 2027.

tools.name: assess_cra_vuln_reporting_readiness
